## Stage 1 Review: Tokio-Free Native Actors

### Verification Summary

| Area | Verification Result |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Default `async` build compatibility** | **Pass.** `default = ["async"]` is enabled in both [rt/Cargo.toml](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/Cargo.toml#L30-L32) and [concurrency/Cargo.toml](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/Cargo.toml#L30-L41). Under `feature = "async"`, [rt/src/sync/mod.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/mod.rs#L3-L4) re-exports `crate::tasks::{watch, CancellationToken}`, preserving Tokio's exact types and runtime semantics. |
| **Races & lost wakeups** | **Pass.** In [rt/src/sync/watch.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L65-L96) (`send_replace`, `Sender::drop`) and [`Changed::poll`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L140-L176), `revision` / `senders` mutations and waiter map extraction/insertion happen atomically under the same `Mutex<State<T>>`. In [`Changed::poll`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L146-L159), `state.revision != this.receiver.seen` is checked before `state.senders == 0`, ensuring a final published exit reason is never lost when the sender drops immediately after publishing. In [`threads::block_on`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/threads/mod.rs#L215-L235), `std::thread::park()` paired with `Thread::unpark()` is race-free because `unpark()` makes the permit available before `park()` sleeps. |
| **Wake / drop under locks** | **Pass.** [`Sender::send_replace`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L65-L75) and [`Sender::drop`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L86-L97) `std::mem::take` the `BTreeMap` and invoke [`wake(waiters)`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L48-L52) and drop `old` value after releasing the mutex guard. [`Changed::poll`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L173) and [`Changed::drop`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L177-L184) explicitly bind replaced/removed `Option<Waker>` values and drop them outside the lock scope. |
| **Cancelled waiter retention** | **Pass.** Each [`Changed`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L136-L184) future owns a unique `registration: Option<u64>` and removes its entry from `state.waiters` on `Drop`. In [concurrency/src/threads/actor.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/threads/actor.rs#L363-L366), moving `MonitorRegistration` into the monitor thread also ensures monitor table entries and their `CancellationToken`s are cleaned up when the monitor exits. |
| **Protocol macro & dependency feature gating** | **Pass.** [macros/src/lib.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/macros/src/lib.rs#L742-L743) wraps the `tasks` blanket impl in [`spawned_concurrency::__spawned_async_items!`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/lib.rs#L110-L119). Because the macro's `#[cfg(feature = "async")]` is evaluated when compiling `spawned-concurrency` rather than at macro-expansion time in the downstream crate, consumer crates defining their own unrelated `async` feature do not trigger `tasks` codegen. |
| **Isolated fixture & dependency graph check** | **Pass.** [examples/thread_only/Cargo.toml](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/examples/thread_only/Cargo.toml) declares an independent `[workspace]` and a consumer `async = []` feature, [examples/thread_only/src/main.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/examples/thread_only/src/main.rs) exercises protocols, sync/async `Response`, registry, monitors, timers, completion waits, links, and metrics, and [scripts/check-thread-only.py](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/scripts/check-thread-only.py) verifies no `tokio*` crate appears in `--edges normal,build`. |

---

### Severity-Ranked Actionable Findings

#### 1. [Medium] Thread-mode `ChildHandle` and link unit tests are completely skipped in `--no-default-features` builds
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/child_handle.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/child_handle.rs#L337-L338), [concurrency/src/child_handle.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/child_handle.rs#L672-L673), [concurrency/src/lib.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/lib.rs#L99-L100)
* **Problem:** Entire test modules (`child_handle::tests`, `child_handle::closed_completion_tests`, and `link_regression_tests`) were gated behind `#[cfg(all(test, feature = "async"))]`. Because `spawned_rt::sync::watch` is an alias for `tokio::sync::watch` whenever `feature = "async"` is active, gating these entire modules on `feature = "async"` means **none of the `ChildHandle` unit tests (including `child_handle_from_threads_basics`, `child_handle_stop`, `child_handle_equality_by_id`, `closure_preserves_the_final_published_reason`, and the `threads = true` half of `closed_without_reason_is_dead_and_all_waits_agree`) ever execute against the new std [`rt/src/sync/watch.rs`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs) implementation**.
* **Actionable Fix:**
  1. Keep `#[cfg(test)]` on `child_handle::tests` and `child_handle::closed_completion_tests`, and gate only the `tasks`-specific helper/tests (`from_tasks`, `Runtime::new`, etc.) with `#[cfg(feature = "async")]`.
  2. In [`closed_completion_tests::closure_preserves_the_final_published_reason`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/child_handle.rs#L727) (and any other shared tests in `child_handle.rs`), use `tx.send_replace(...)` (or add `Sender::send` to [`rt/src/sync/watch.rs`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs)) so the tests compile and run under `--no-default-features`.
  3. Similarly, inside `link_regression_tests`, gate only the async/tasks tests on `#[cfg(feature = "async")]` so thread-mode link regression tests run against the Tokio-free runtime.

#### 2. [Low] CI does not clippy-check `spawned-rt` / `spawned-concurrency` directly or test without `metrics` in `thread-only` mode
* **Location:** [.github/workflows/ci.yml](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L55-L62)
* **Problem:**
  1. Every `spawned-concurrency` and `examples/thread_only` command in the `thread-only` job enables `metrics` (`--features threads,metrics` and `--features metrics,async`). A bare `--no-default-features` (or `--no-default-features --features threads` without `metrics`) build is never tested, leaving the `(not(async), not(metrics))` cfg quadrant unverified in CI.
  2. `cargo clippy` is only run with `--manifest-path examples/thread_only/Cargo.toml`. Because `examples/thread_only` is an isolated workspace, Cargo will not lint `--tests` in `spawned-rt` or `spawned-concurrency` under `--no-default-features`.
* **Actionable Fix:** Add `cargo test --locked -p spawned-concurrency --no-default-features` and `cargo clippy --locked -p spawned-rt -p spawned-concurrency --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` to the `thread-only` CI job.

#### 3. [Low] Public `spawned_rt::sync::watch::Ref` holds a `MutexGuard` rather than a shared read lock, and `Sender::send` is missing in `no-default-features`
* **Location:** [rt/src/sync/watch.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L31-L37), [rt/src/sync/watch.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L53-L76)
* **Problem:**
  1. `spawned_rt::sync` is `pub mod sync`. Under `feature = "async"`, `watch::Ref` is backed by Tokio's `RwLock` (allowing multiple concurrent readers and nested `borrow()` calls on the same thread) and `Sender` exposes `.send(val)`. Under `not(feature = "async")`, `watch::Ref` holds an exclusive `std::sync::MutexGuard<'a, State<T>>` (so holding a `Ref` across a second `borrow()`, `has_changed()`, or `send_replace()` on the same thread will deadlock) and `Sender::send` is absent.
  2. All current internal callers in `spawned-concurrency` immediately clone the small value and drop `Ref`, so no deadlock exists today, but external or future callers of `spawned_rt::sync::watch` can hit this behavioral difference between feature modes.
* **Actionable Fix:** Either document on `rt/src/sync/watch.rs` that `Ref` holds an exclusive mutex guard and must not be held across other `watch` operations on the same thread (and optionally add `Sender::send` for API parity), or restrict `pub mod sync` visibility if it is only intended for internal workspace use.

#### 4. [Low] Minor cleanup in `CancellationToken` and `Changed::poll`
* **Location:** [rt/src/sync/mod.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/mod.rs#L9-L28), [rt/src/sync/watch.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L144-L172)
* **Problem:**
  1. `CancellationToken(std::sync::Arc<watch::Sender<bool>>)` double-wraps `watch::Sender<bool>` in an outer `Arc` even though `watch::Sender<bool>` is already `Clone` via its internal `Arc<Inner<bool>>`. Also, in [`CancellationToken::cancelled`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/mod.rs#L20-L27), `let _ = receiver.changed().await;` ignores `Err(RecvError)`; although `&self` keeps a `Sender` alive today, returning on `Err` prevents a latent busy-spin if an owned cancellation future is ever introduced.
  2. In [`Changed::poll`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/rt/src/sync/watch.rs#L144), `let waker = cx.waker().clone();` runs unconditionally before locking, cloning and dropping the waker even when `poll` takes the `Poll::Ready` branch.
* **Actionable Fix:** Move `cx.waker().clone()` into the `Poll::Pending` branch of `Changed::poll`, and break/return on `receiver.changed().await.is_err()` in `CancellationToken::cancelled`.

---

### Explicit Verdict

**APPROVE WITH MINOR REVISIONS** — The Stage 1 architecture, concurrency synchronization (`watch` and `CancellationToken`), lock-free waker/value dropping, dependency-scoped protocol macro gating (`__spawned_async_items!`), and isolated Tokio-free dependency graph verification are sound and free of races, lost wakeups, or deadlocks in current usage. Before merging or moving to Stage 2, ungate the thread-mode tests in `child_handle.rs` (and `link_regression_tests`) so they run under `--no-default-features` against the new `rt/src/sync/watch.rs` implementation, and expand the `thread-only` CI step to cover clippy and non-`metrics` builds.
